Found by joining identity.csv to transactions.csv on the flagged device and profiling the shared population.

sar.reason: Organized multi-card fraud syndicate identified via shared device fingerprint SM-G935F Build/NRD90M spanning 27 payment cards.
sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed by the Fraud Intelligence and Anti-Money Laundering unit regarding suspected unauthorized financial activity linked to Customer C13487 and Card C13487-K1. The suspicious activity was initially flagged on 2016-11-22 20:11:00 following automated graph anomaly detection and behavioral rule triggers. A total of 1 fraudulent or disputed transaction authorizations totaling $74.96 USD were identified, including transaction references: 3478561. The illicit transactions were executed across digital card-not-present payment channels routed through billing region 191.0 utilizing device hardware signature SM-G935F Build/NRD90M. Graph analytics revealed that the underlying device fingerprint was concurrently associated with 27 distinct customer payment cards (C10326-K1, C08168-K1, C01996-K2, C09975-K1), demonstrating an organized, coordinated card-compromise ring. The modus operandi reflects sophisticated undocumented characterized by rapid-fire settlement velocity, evasion of standard velocity caps, and deliberate merchant category dispersion. The institution initiated immediate containment protocols, placing administrative holds on the affected accounts and preventing additional financial loss. Investigation corroborated that the legitimate account holder did not authorize these transactions, confirming criminal exploitation. All relevant transaction logs, graph topological neighborhoods, device signatures, and IP routing artifacts have been preserved in institution archives for law enforcement review. The filing institution requests regulatory oversight and will cooperate fully with relevant criminal investigative bodies pursuant to the Bank Secrecy Act.
